item.title: Learning about "The Unix Time-Sharing System"
item.description:
📝 Dennis Ritchie, The Unix Time-Sharing System Unix was initially written by Ken Thompson. Nobody had solved this before. When you're reading a file, you're almost always certain that the data will be read sequentially, and you're not surprised when you fault a and read a + 1.
🔗 Read more: https://playtechnique.io/long/the-unix-time-sharing-system.html

item.title: Belgian car salesman becomes prince after DNA test proves royal parentage
item.description:
📝 Clément Vandenkerckhove became a Belgian prince after a paternity test confirmed his biological father to be Prince Laurent, brother to the King of Belgium. Prince Laurent has registered his paternity of Vandenkerckhove with Belgium’s civil registry, The Telegraph reported on Wednesday. Daelemans/Photonews/Getty Images In a documentary that aired on Belgian network VTM last September, Vandenkerckhove recounted his mother’s admission that Laurent was his father.
🔗 Read more: https://www.cnn.com/2026/08/22/europe/prince-belgium-secret-son-scli-intl
